Hi Ellen — great to hear. Short answer: we can accommodate an invoice-first flow for time-limited pilots with a temporary no-PO exception, provided a few controls are in place. Proposed terms below that Procurement can review: 

- Scope: 90-day pilot scoped in attached SOW ("Nebula_Redwood_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf").
- Billing: Redwood to invoice Nebula at the start of the pilot for the agreed pilot fee; additional usage billed monthly.
- Payment terms: Net 30.
- PO: No PO required for the 90-day pilot provided total expected spend <= $25,000 and Nebula completes our temporary vendor onboarding form.
- Docs: Signed SOW + countersigned MSA or e-signed MSA link required prior to provisioning.
- Compliance: We will provide SOC2 Type II report and data handling summary upon request.

If Procurement needs a formal exemption request, we can route it through Finance for approval — Monica, can you weigh in on the $25k threshold and any required approvals?

Attachments: Nebula_Redwood_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW)

Thanks,

Rafael / Laura —

Quick finance note on temporary no-PO flows: Finance will approve exceptions for pilots under $25k total ARR provided the following are completed before provisioning:
1) Customer completes temporary vendor onboarding form (I attached a fillable version in similar threads; see Nebula_temp_vendor_form.pdf).
2) W-9 or equivalent tax form on file (US entities).
3) Signed SOW and countersigned MSA (or DocuSign envelope in progress).
4) P-Card option documented if Procurement prefers card payments for small pilots.

If any single-month invoices are expected > $10k, we require either a PO or an explicit CFO approval on the exception. For long-term or production accounts we require standard PO + vendor setup.

I'll review the SOW and confirm via email once the vendor form + W-9 are received. Rafael — happy to own the approval path once we have the completed forms.

Thanks,

Thanks all — legal quick note: we can accept the temporary no-PO invoice flow but require the following before sign-off:
- Countersigned MSA (DocuSign link to be provided) or an email from Nebula confirming MSA acceptance.
- Data Processing Addendum executed if Nebula plans to send PII.
- Limitation: exception is only for this 90-day SOW; any extension or production rollout will require standard procurement PO and vendor onboarding.

Rafael — please request DocuSign from the contact who executed the commercial terms. Procurement, if you need a redline deck I can prepare limited changes, but prefer to keep MSA standard for expediency.
